question: Through whose grace has the determination of the Kaula doctrine become known?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Knowledge arose by that lord's grace
The object known is the determination of Kaula
inference: The Kaula determination is known by the grace of the lord of Kaulas.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
